translations.web: then Jeremiah went out of Jerusalem to go into the land of Benjamin, to receive his portion there, in the middle of the people.
translations.bsb: Jeremiah started to leave Jerusalem to go to the land of Benjamin to claim his portion there among the people.
translations.kjv: Then Jeremiah went forth out of Jerusalem to go into the land of Benjamin, to separate himself thence in the midst of the people.
